sloka: ततो निक्षिप्य मातऽ: स अयोध्यायां दृढव्रत: ।भरत: शोकसन्तप्तो गुरूनिदमथाब्रवीत् ॥ २.११५.१॥
transliteration: tato nikṣipya māta': sa ayodhyāyāṁ dṛḍhavrata: ।bharata: śokasantapto gurūnidamathābravīt ॥ 2.115.1॥

translations.english: After keeping his mothers in Ayodhya, the griefstricken Bharata who was firm in his vows, said to the elders:
